resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says 6 miles south of Plains; the 2018 Sanders County Ledger says about 15 miles south. The story reports both.
The Register says it was condemned, with no date. firelookout.com says it was destroyed in 1968 and replaced by a cupola trailer. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Current 2026 staffing is not verified. The newest staffing report read is the June 2018 Ledger article, and the Register and firelookout.com are undated. Access and visit rules are not stated. The record's coordinates match the Register (47.37222, -114.85889). Recommend the Lolo National Forest Plains/Thompson Falls Ranger District confirm current staffing and access. The distance and fate-of-1934-tower conflicts are reported in the story, not resolved.
